notes: Installing 5.52.0 printed: *"it uses the legacy commands/ format. Both formats work — consider migrating to skills/*/SKILL.md."* Both do work, and there is no published removal date — but the migration is not the file move it looks like. A command is never model-invoked. It runs when, and only when, the user types it. A skill is model-invoked, from its description. So moving seven commands/*.md into skills/*/SKILL.md unchanged would have silently converted seven user-initiated entry points into seven things Claude may decide to run on its own — and two of them write: /ots:setup stores an API k
